newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Dec S&P 500 futures rise more late, end strong.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Dec S&P 500 futures rise more late, end strong.

text.p: Oct 18 - U.S. Dec S&P 500 futures rose more late to new all-time high, ended strong. Traders tied late rise to signs of big fund buying in cash, strong upside momentum, Oct OEX expiry-related share buying. Preclosing NYSE order imbalances were large, buyside. Some arb buy programs took advantage of wide premium. S&P 500 futures volume estimated near 66,000. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
